#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""
Push a local document into the manifold wiki via the MCP server's /ingest endpoint.

Usage:
    python3 tools/ingest_doc.py <component> <file_path> [doc_type]

Arguments:
    component   Component slug, e.g. "acme-api"
    file_path   Absolute or relative path to the document file
    doc_type    Optional: readme | architecture | api | other
                Auto-detected from filename if omitted.

Examples:
    python3 tools/ingest_doc.py acme-api README.md
    python3 tools/ingest_doc.py acme-api /home/me/dev/acme-api/ARCHITECTURE.md architecture
    python3 tools/ingest_doc.py acme-api docs/API.md api

Output on success:
    ✅  Ingested → raw/acme-api/<date>-acme-api-architecture.md  (4821 bytes)

The MCP server must be running at the URL configured below (default: http://127.0.0.1:8686).
The server always requires a credential of your own (issued to you by whoever runs the server). Put it in
the MANIFOLD_TOKEN environment variable (that is only the name of the variable; the value is YOUR
credential, not a shared token). You also need a write grant on the component.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from pathlib import Path


DEFAULT_SERVER_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8686"


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Push a local doc file into the manifold wiki raw/ directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("component", help="Component slug, e.g. acme-api")
    parser.add_argument("file_path", help="Path to the document file")
    parser.add_argument(
        "doc_type",
        nargs="?",
        default="",
        help="Doc type: readme | architecture | api | other (auto-detected if omitted)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--server",
        default=DEFAULT_SERVER_URL,
        help=f"MCP server URL (default: {DEFAULT_SERVER_URL})",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    path = Path(args.file_path)
    if not path.exists():
        print(f"❌  File not found: {path}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    if not path.is_file():
        print(f"❌  Not a file: {path}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    payload = json.dumps({
        "component": args.component,
        "doc_type":  args.doc_type,
        "content":   content,
        "filename":  path.name,   # used by server to derive a unique dated slug
    }).encode("utf-8")

    url = args.server.rstrip("/") + "/ingest"

    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    token = os.environ.get("MANIFOLD_TOKEN", "").strip()  # the name of the variable that holds YOUR credential
    if token:
        headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + token

    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, headers=headers, method="POST")

    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            body = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        try:
            msg = json.loads(raw).get("message", raw)
        except Exception:
            msg = raw
        print(f"❌  Server error {e.code}: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
        if e.code == 401:
            print("    The server needs your credential: set MANIFOLD_TOKEN to it in your environment "
                  "(it may also have been revoked or expired: ask whoever runs the server).", file=sys.stderr)
        elif e.code == 403:
            print("    Your credential is not allowed to add documents for this component (a write grant is needed).",
                  file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    except urllib.error.URLError as e:
        print(f"❌  Could not reach MCP server at {url}: {e.reason}", file=sys.stderr)
        print(
            "    Is the server running? From the manifold repo: ./svc_ctl.sh dev start",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    if body.get("status") == "ok":
        out_path = body.get("path", "?")
        byte_count = body.get("bytes", len(content))
        print(f"✅  Ingested → {out_path}  ({byte_count} bytes)")
    else:
        msg = body.get("message", json.dumps(body))
        print(f"❌  Ingest failed: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

files.name: ingest_doc

---
mode: agent
description: Post a cross-component handoff to the manifold wiki
tools: ['manifold/*']
---

Post a new handoff to the manifold wiki using wiki_handoff_tool.

Call wiki_handoff_tool with:
  action: "create"
  source: "<source component slug>"
  target: "<target component slug>"
  type: "<feature | bug | breaking-change | integration-spec>"
  priority: "<critical | high | medium | low>"
  title: "<one-line description of the work>"
  summary: "<one paragraph: what needs to happen and why>"
  what_needs_to_happen: "<bulleted list of specific tasks for the target>"
  technical_details: "<API changes, schemas, data contracts, edge cases>"

If you are not sure of a value, ask before calling the tool.
After the tool returns, confirm the path and tell the user the handoff is live.
files.description: Copilot slash command: /handoff-create — post a new handoff
files.name: handoff-create-prompt

files.content:
---
mode: agent
description: Discover and claim open handoffs for this component
tools: ['manifold/*']
---

Find and claim a handoff for this component from the manifold wiki.

Step 1: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="list", target="<this-component>", status_filter="open")
Step 2: Show the user the list of open handoffs with title, source, and priority.
Step 3: Ask which one to claim (if more than one).
Step 4: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="claim", path="<selected path>")
Step 5: Show the summary and what_needs_to_happen from the response.
        This is the work brief — start implementation from here.
files.description: Copilot slash command: /handoff-pickup — find and claim open handoffs
files.name: handoff-pickup-prompt

files.content:
---
mode: agent
description: Close a handoff this component raised (source only) and record the resolution
tools: ['manifold/*']
---

Close a handoff that this component raised, in the manifold wiki.

Only the source of a handoff closes it. If this component is the target (it is doing the work),
do not close: request review with /handoff-update, and the source confirms or closes it.

Step 1: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="list", status_filter="needs-review") (and "in-progress")
        and keep the handoffs whose source_component is this component, or use the path if already known.
Step 2: Ask the user to describe what was checked and accepted (what the target delivered, how it was verified).
Step 3: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="close", path="<path>", resolution="<description>")
        If the server answers that this component is not the source, stop and tell the user.
Step 4: Read wiki/components/<this-component>.md and add a ## Changelog entry
        describing the result. Update last_updated to today.
Step 5: Confirm completion to the user.
files.description: Copilot slash command: /handoff-close — close a handoff this component raised (source only)
files.name: handoff-close-prompt

---
mode: agent
description: Install the latest manifold helper files into this component repo
tools: ['manifold/*']
---

Install the latest manifold helper files into this component repo.

Step 1: Call wiki_export_component_helpers_tool(). It returns a "files" list.
        Each entry has: name, output_path, content.

Step 2: Write EVERY file to its output_path. Do not skip any file for any
        reason. If a file already exists, overwrite it with the new content.
        If it does not exist, create it.

Step 3: After writing, note which files were newly created vs overwritten vs
        already identical (for the report). This is for reporting only — it
        does not affect which files get written.

Step 4: Stage ONLY the files you just wrote (their exact output_paths).
        Do not stage any other files in the repo.
        Commit: "chore: update manifold helpers"

Step 5: Report: how many files were written, how many were already current.
        List any files that are new (did not previously exist).
files.description: Copilot slash command: /manifold-update — check and install manifold helper updates
files.name: manifold-update-prompt

files.content:
---
mode: agent
description: Submit your implementation for source review
tools: ['manifold/*']
---

Submit a completed handoff implementation for source review.

Step 1: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="list", target="<this-component>", status_filter="in-progress")
        to find the active handoff, or use the path if already known.
Step 2: Ask the user to describe what was implemented — what changed, which files,
        how it addresses the handoff requirements.
Step 3: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="request-review", path="<path>", notes="<description>")
Step 4: Confirm to the user: the handoff is now awaiting source review (status: needs-review).
        Tell them the source component should run /handoff-confirm or /handoff-reject.
files.description: Copilot slash command: /handoff-update — submit implementation for source review
files.name: handoff-update-prompt

files.content:
---
mode: agent
description: Confirm the target component's implementation satisfies this handoff
tools: ['manifold/*']
---

Review and confirm a handoff implementation from the source component's perspective.

Step 1: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="list", source="<this-component>", status_filter="needs-review")
        to find handoffs awaiting your review. Show each one's title and implementation notes.
Step 2: Ask the user: is the implementation satisfactory?
Step 3a: If yes — call wiki_handoff_tool(action="confirm", path="<path>", notes="<optional note>")
         Then prompt the user to close any related handoffs in the opposite direction
         with /handoff-close.
Step 3b: If no — use /handoff-reject to send it back with feedback.
files.description: Copilot slash command: /handoff-confirm — confirm target's implementation
files.name: handoff-confirm-prompt

files.content:
---
mode: agent
description: Reject a handoff implementation and request rework
tools: ['manifold/*']
---

Reject a handoff implementation from the source component's perspective.

Step 1: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="list", source="<this-component>", status_filter="needs-review")
        to find the handoff. Show the current implementation notes.
Step 2: Ask the user to describe specifically what is wrong or insufficient.
Step 3: Call wiki_handoff_tool(action="reject", path="<path>", notes="<feedback>")
Step 4: Confirm to the user: the handoff is back in-progress with your feedback
        in ## Blockers. The target should run /handoff-update again when ready.
files.description: Copilot slash command: /handoff-reject — reject implementation and request rework
files.name: handoff-reject-prompt
